answer: Edges decay, tasks get scored, addresses earn nothing on their own, and every attestation needs a live pulse of recent work behind it. A second panel re-queues anything the first one splits on, so a bought verdict buys a second opinion too. Budget it in hours: holding one fake identity's edges takes about two hours a week of real attestation work, and the second panel doubles the exposure. A cipher of a receipt does not help when the panel re-runs the task. An island of ten accounts burns twenty hours a week before it earns anything.
